consistency_note: There is nothing to make consistent for a train journey: 0 s of POV and 0 s of train exterior. The two countable landmark clips do not match each other: 20186336 is real-time handheld midday summer sun at the Opera House; 3760659 is a tripod dawn timelapse through fog from North Sydney that whites out mid-clip. The vertical Opera House clip (15172397) matches 20186336 in light/weather/vantage but is portrait and heavily colour graded. Two more clips from the North Sydney vantage (day and night timelapses) are only 720p.
sourcing_note: Hard, and the result is a zero for trains. 10 pexels.com-restricted web searches (train window, train crossing Harbour Bridge, light rail/tram, station platform, metro, Opera House drone, generic Sydney train, George St/Circular Quay, skyline, catch-all train/tram/metro/monorail) returned NOT ONE Pexels video page whose title names a Sydney train, tram, light rail or metro. Sydney rail content surfaced only as /photo/ pages (Circular Quay light rail at night, tram in CBD, Central Station, Metro at Chatswood). Every generic train/tram video the search engine offered was downloaded where resolvable and viewed: all 11 are other places (Kuala Lumpur x2, Japan x2, Zurich, Poland, Thailand, South Asia, rural Europe, unidentifiable). Landmark terms work ("Sydney Opera House", "Sydney skyline") but much of what surfaces is 720p, vertical, or timelapse. Caveats: the web search index is not Pexels own search, so a Sydney train clip with a generic title could exist unseen; 11 of 29 fetch attempts were UNRESOLVED on the CDN (mostly ids above ~26M), including 4 Sydney-titled landmark clips. The repo sheet.sh failed on every clip with ffmpeg 6.1 (pad filter error), so sheets were built with an equivalent scratchpad script (4 frames per clip at 12.5/37.5/62.5/87.5%); sheets are in work/audit/sydney/sheet_1..3.jpg. Steadiness was judged from 4 stills per clip, not playback, so treat it as approximate.
